Schnittstelle H2Monadic<WT extends org.quurz.foomp.higher.WitnessType, A, R>

Typparameter:
WT - the witness type representing the higher‑kinded constructor
A - the mapped/bound (first) type parameter
R - the preserved (second) type parameter, e.g. a result/context type
Alle Superschnittstellen:
H2Appliable<WT,A,R>, H2Bindable<WT,A,R>, H2Mappable<WT,A,R>
Alle bekannten Implementierungsklassen:
Continuation, Stateful
public interface H2Monadic<WT extends org.quurz.foomp.higher.WitnessType, A, R> extends H2Mappable<WT,A,R>, H2Appliable<WT,A,R>, H2Bindable<WT,A,R>

Rank‑2 monad‑like interface: combines the contracts of H2Mappable, H2Appliable and H2Bindable. Operations map/flatMap over the first type parameter while preserving the second parameter R (e.g. result/context).

Typical use cases are structures like State<S, A> or Cont<R, A>, which behave monadically in A with a fixed S/R.

Contract: transformations must not be null and must not return null; implementations should return non‑null results and keep R unchanged.
